correctness.rationale: At most two peripheral vertices can branch across three hubs without a cycle. Explicit symbolic enumeration of four marked neighborhoods and zero, one or two unmarked branching vertices gives Z, Z_X and Z_XY. Exact factorization gives 12v^5 R with nonnegative coefficients and positive constant. CHECK.py reproduced the symbolic all-n identities and independently enumerated 1856, 9984 and 51712 forests for n=4,5,6. Finite checks are supplementary, not the infinite proof.
